verdict.rationale: First-party docs say a profile persists cookies, local storage and login state across browsers. The documented workflow is to log in once, save the profile, then reuse it so future browsers start already logged in. The 2FA guide also names saved profiles as the most reliable way to handle auth, and a community user confirms reusing an already-logged-in profile works locally (LinkedIn automation). Missing for 10: documented API details for creating, listing and managing profiles; independent hands-on corroboration of the cloud saved-profile feature specifically.
